item.title: Arc Raiders developer finally addresses theories over matchmaking, confirms player behaviour is a factor in who you're playing against
item.description: Arc Raiders art director Robert Sammelin has shone some light on the inner workings of the extraction shooter's matchmaking system, confirming that player behaviour is indeed a factor in the "complex" process of assigning players to online matches. Read more

item.title: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 gets sales and player boost after historic The Game Awards win
item.description: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 has been going from strength to strength this year. Following its release back in April, the game was met with widespread acclaim and sales to match. In May, the developer revealed it had passed a fitting milestone of 3.3m copies sold. In October, that figure was updated to over 5m copies worldwide across all formats. Read more

item.title: Divinity will be a turn-based RPG and see Larian "unleashed", declares CEO Swen Vincke, replacing the D&D system with one "made for a video game"

item.title: Larian is using generative AI, confirms CEO, but Divinity won't contain anything AI-generated
item.description: Larian is using generative AI as part of its game development process, but CEO Swen Vincke has confirmed the studio's new Divinity game won't include anything AI-generated. Read more
